code:
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE raw.orders (
  order_id    string,
  customer_id string,
  order_total double,
  order_date  date
)
STORED AS PARQUET
LOCATION 's3://my-data-lake/raw/orders/';
caption: Metadata pointing at S3 — the same Catalog entry a crawler would create.

code:
SELECT customer_id,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count,
       SUM(order_total) AS lifetime_value
FROM raw.orders
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC
LIMIT 10;
caption: Ordinary ANSI SQL — billed by the bytes it scans in raw.orders.

subtitle: How a crawler run makes new data queryable instantly.
